title: JAAO SIDHAARO RAN KI TARAF MERE NAUNE HAAL
body:
Maidaan me jo Shah ne halmin ki di sada
Asghar ne Apne jhoole se Khud ko gira diya
Maa ne kaha ke Tum bhi chale MereDilruba
Achha Main ye judaai bhi sehlungi MereLaal
<<MINI>>
Jaao Sidhaaro ran ki taraf Mere Naune haal
<<DIVIDER>>
Armaa'n bahot the koi na hasrat nikal saki
Tha chaar din ka saat ye mujhko khabar na thi
Jee bhar ke pyaar bhi toMain kar paai na abhi
Beta tamaam umr rahega yehi maLaal
<<MINI>>
Jaao Sidhaaro ran ki taraf Mere Naune haal
<<DIVIDER>>
Waat-e sehr se asr talak ghar ka ghar luta
Abbas 0 Qasim o Ali Akbar huwe judaa
Ab Tum bhi jaane waale ho Maa Tum pa ho fida
Lekin abhi bhi sabr karungi me khasta haal
<<MINI>>
Jaao Sidhaaro ran ki taraf Mere Naune haal
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaate ho rann ko thehro Main gesu sanwaar dun
Godi meAao Tumko Main ji bhar ke pyaar dun
Ruk jaao MereLaal ke sadqga utaar dun
Apni Amaa'n me rakhe Tujhe Rabbe ZuljaLaal
<<MINI>>
Jaao Sidhaaro ran ki taraf Mere Naune haal
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Main watan ko laot karAye Laal jaaungi
Sughra jo Tumko poochhegi kuch keh na paaungi
Ro'ungi khaali jhoola Tumhara jhulaaungi
Deen e Rasool eHaq ki ye izzat ka hai sawaal
<<MINI>>
Jaao Sidhaaro ran ki taraf Mere Naune haal
<<DIVIDER>>
Bechain-o beqaraar ho Tum jang ke liye
Sukhi zaba'n hai pyaase ho Tum teen roz se
Is ke siwa hain aur bhi kitne hi marhale
Tum ko magar hai maqsade Shabbir ka khayal
<<MINI>>
Jaao Sidhaaro ran ki taraf Mere Naune haal
author: Ali Irfan
